title: Resume a durable local plan after a crash
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. A local plan's require_file node fails when `/work/input.txt` is missing on the virtual filesystem. He observes that failure, seeds the file into MemoryFilesystem, and resumes the same checkpointed `run_id` (held on walk-bag `ctx`) so the node succeeds. Checkpoints — not chat — carry the plan across the gap. Incompatible harness fingerprints remain covered by `fangore_insp_durable_resume`. See inspiration requirements for durable long-running work[^insp-resume].
implementation: `LocalPlanResumeVerb` (`local_plan_resume`) in `cli_policy_verbs`: shared `MemoryFilesystem` + `GraphExecutor` checkpoint store; fail on missing path; seed; re-arm failed node; `resume=True` with the same `run_id` on walk-bag `ctx`. Fan-in / merge / precondition helpers stay available as library units; fingerprint refuse is `fangore_insp_durable_resume`.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `local_plan_resume`; expects first_status=failed (missing_file), resume_status=ok, file_content, and stable run_id.
